role: frequency-ordered word list (full list; the app bundles its head as the seed)
generationVersion: gen-tatoeba-words.py v1 (HKeyboard scripts/; Batch 8 added the bengali script filter, whose vowel signs / virama / anusvara are letters of the word)
generationCommand: python gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang bn --script bengali --min-count 3 --stop "টম,টমের,টমকে,মেরি,মেরির,মেরিকে,টমও,টমেট" --out bn_words.txt ben_text.txt
transformations: gen-tatoeba-words.py: tokens of Bengali letters and their combining marks; Tatoeba placeholder names dropped (--stop); words seen fewer than 3 times dropped; ordered by count desc then first occurrence
no corpus sentence is redistributed - the file is a word list only
note: The app bundles the top 900 lines as its seed and downloads this full list on the user's request.
